result.summary:
REQ-ANALYST: REQ-006 appended to docs/requirements.yaml after REQ-005, status pending, owner ORCH, depends_on [REQ-005], 17 acceptance criteria; every criterion ends with «Проверка:» (grep, wc, jq, awk, snapshot-diff, or a named validator step). The file still parses as YAML (ruby Psych: REQ-001..REQ-006). A script confirmed that original_request quotes «Делай», ORCH's section-4 plan and the reviewer's section-3 condition word for word from docs/business-plan/reviews/2026-09-30-external-review.md.
What REQ-006 sets: brief docs/business-plan/pixel-office-brief.md; new research files research/session-review-platforms.md (Q1: is whole-session review already native in Claude Code / other platforms, phrased as a question) and research/session-review-tools.md; research/pixel-office.md is left unchanged. Both research files carry a coverage table with 6 element columns and cell values limited to да/частично/нет/не найдено. That table makes «убедительно» checkable. Value gate 2a/2b: one sentence between <!-- value:start/end -->, at most 60 words, $10 marked «допущение»; a competitor table with rows for Claude Code, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Prompt Coach, Pretty Prompt and each overlapping product found; 2b records verdict, reasons marked «по существу» or «оформление», urls_opened, and headings (only the value section may exist at that point). There are two outcomes, and each has exact «## » headings: «проверка на 14 дней» with 9 sections, or «рано» with 4 sections: attempts quoted from the 2a handoffs, what to learn first, and no 14-day test. «рано» is a valid completion. Length: wc -w <= 1500. The 14-day test has success/stop/«мало данных» thresholds counted only in received money, a separate intermediate-signals subsection, and no Д7 or active-user denominator. Scenarios: at least 3 prices × at least 3 page-visitor shares. Sourcing follows REQ-005 AC4. snapshot-diff proves the big plan, pixel-office.md, the mandates and REQ-006 did not change. Handoff names are fixed per step, and rework files are -rN with result.changes. Step 5 (ORCH-checked): the AP entry must contain «594»/«Д7»; STATE.md gets 2 follow-ups; a WF-07 section «## Вариант: короткий документ с воротами ценности».
OPEN QUESTIONS: (1) The owner-approved plan, item 3, says «Отклонил — стоп»; the task asked for WF-07 rework limits. REQ-006 reconciles them: a substantive rejection means «рано» at once; only formatting defects get up to 2 reworks. The owner/ORCH should confirm this, or drop the reworks. (2) The task puts Prompt Coach under GitHub Copilot, but research/pixel-office.md:168 ties it to Microsoft 365 Copilot. REQ-006 lists GitHub Copilot and Microsoft Prompt Coach as separate rows. (3) Two limits are my own conversions, open to adjustment: 1500 words ≈ «2–3 страницы» at about 500 words/page, with no lower bound; and 60 words for the value sentence. (4) plan-writer.md sources exclude README.md and the reviews file. REQ-006 therefore carries the needed lines (503, 504, 420–421, 570, 571, 578–580, 586, 593–595), so no mandate change is needed mid-run (AP-011). plan-validator.md step 1b still says «REQ-005 criteria govern», so ORCH's handoffs must say REQ-006 governs. (5) The criterion covering DOC-UPDATER's work is checked by ORCH, not RELEASE-VALIDATOR, because it runs after step 4 (context.orch_check). (6) The step-00b file name and the snapshot at handoffs/<BP-ID>/snapshot-before.txt are my choices. (7) context.agent_run_id of this handoff was filled by ORCH during the step (a4782636cdabc16f1); criterion 16 covers it. (8) Sizing: 17 criteria for a whole WF-07 run, the same pattern as REQ-005. REQ-VALIDATOR may want a split.
